# About MGenética

MGenética is a public educational publication focused on animal breeding, quantitative genetics and applied genomics with reproducible R practice.

## Public principles

::: {.profile-grid}
::: {.profile-card}
### Scientific clarity

Each technical output should map to a biological/statistical question.
:::

::: {.profile-card}
### Reproducibility

Modules keep links to scripts and simulated data for re-execution.
:::

::: {.profile-card}
### Editorial-first experience

Public site stays content-focused; internal management stays internal.
:::
:::
